ns2:course.label: Case Studies Professional Ethics and Education
ns2:course.description: Examines issues in moral philosophy as they pertain to education. Topics include current theories of moral education, ethical problems in teaching, or topics of moral dispute in educational policy. Same as EPS 517. 4 graduate hours. No professional credit. Prerequisite: Consent of instructor.
